limitations: This is a target-free behavior comparison, not an accuracy or quality evaluation.
Changed rankings do not imply better rankings.
The full252-pool denominator is retained;35 whole menus were not neurally scored, and no unsupported candidates were removed.
Student-held-out scenes originate from the teacher-seen original training domain; this is not teacher-unseen generalization.
Target labels and the final acceptance set were not read in this scoring experiment.
Original-order fallback is an offline policy, not a native Rime replay or Windows product acceptance.
No private input, candidate text, tokens, individual scores, data hashes, private paths, remote identifiers, or weights are included.
